trades.lesson: FILL PRICE NOT RECORDED — the attribution below is inferred from the P&L alone and cannot see where you got in or out. Add entry_fill and exit_fill to make it real. Filled, went the right way by 0.0 points, never reached T1, and closed without the stop. The TARGET was too far for the session. This is the failure that target-odds.ts exists to predict — check what reach the desk quoted against what it actually got.
